text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President of the Republic of Srpska, Biljana Plavsic, and deputy to Carl Bildt, Michael Steiner, agreed in principle on release of POWs, return of refugees and displaced persons and procedures related to war crimes in Banjaluka on Tuesday.
- Michael Steiner said the file accusing Bosnian President Alija Izetbegovic for war crimes and submitted to the Hague by Serb authorities "is political provocation".
- International Mediator for the Federation, Christian Schwarz Schilling, said that Croat and Moslem partners agreed on full implementation of the Federation at all levels by January 1 1997.
- Swiss governement decided to repatriate some Bosnian refugees by April 1997 according to president of the Bosnian refugees association.
